analyst_view.overall: Early view: Celta Fortuna are 16th and their home games are open (13 scored, 13 conceded in seven), while Mallorca are sixth under Luis García and very tight away (seven goals in six away games, four of them draws). Celta Fortuna's squad also depends on what the Celta first team needs, and one preview listed four injured players.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean slightly lower: Mallorca's away games have averaged just over one goal, and they should control this game, even though Celta Fortuna's home matches are usually open.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. I found nothing that points clearly either way, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards. I lean higher: Mallorca average three yellows a game (36 in 12), and Celta Fortuna have four players who reached five yellows, so both sides pick up plenty of bookings.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. I lean slightly lower: Mallorca's away games are slow and controlled, and Celta Fortuna managed only six shots at Burgos.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 shots on target. I lean lower: Celta Fortuna had one on target at Burgos, and Mallorca's away games rarely produce many clear chances.
